slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: collection_title
slots.about: the title on the collection card

slots.name: categories
slots.about: the categories in a fixed order: id, name, icon (a Tabler icon name), found, total, open (false keeps it a locked placeholder)

slots.name: info_text
slots.about: the short note the info button opens in place

slots.name: locked_name
slots.about: the name shown under a locked tile

slots.name: locked_hint
slots.about: the line a tap on a locked tile shows: how to open one

slots.name: of_word
slots.about: between found and total when spoken or written out

slots.name: found_word
slots.about: after the total on the picked line

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when there is no category

fallback.shows: a locked tile keeps its place: dim, a question mark, locked_name, no count, spoken as locked_word

attention.shows: the picked tile fills; the line under the grid gives its count, or locked_hint for a locked tile

labels.tile: name with found of total, or locked_word

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: Fixed order from the data, open and locked mixed, so a category opening changes in place and nothing reflows.
